fields.FIR_Description: According to the complaint registered on 2026-02-09, a caller claiming to be a bank executive asked the complainant to install a support application, after which Rs. 96,000 was withdrawn. The incident is stated to have occurred on 2026-02-09 around 08:15 hrs. The online submission was made by Madhan Rajan (9000000143). Tamilarasan Velan (9000000281) noticed the incident and may be able to provide a statement. Prakash Muthu (mobile 9000000312) was named as a possible person of interest. Funds were reportedly sent to the account reference SYN-ACC-100020. Siva Muthu (9000000256), described as an intermediary, was also mentioned in the complaint.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Caller allegedly posed as a bank executive and asked for remote access.
fields.Keywords: phishing, suspicious link, receiving account, morning, college road, associate, suspect, mobile number
